output: html_document

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

analysis_df <- read_csv("../data/analysis_df.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Lake Location Overview

```{r}
lake_map_df <- analysis_df %>%
  group_by(lake, latitude, longitude) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_doc = mean(doc_mgl, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_trophic = mean(trophic_position, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude))

ggplot(lake_map_df, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = mean_doc)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  coord_quickmap() +
  labs(
    title = "Lake locations colored by mean DOC",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "Mean DOC"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Focused Map of High-DOC Lakes

```{r}
top_doc <- lake_map_df %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_doc)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 12)

ggplot(top_doc, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, label = lake, size = mean_trophic)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2c7fb8", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(check_overlap = TRUE, hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.15, size = 3) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  labs(
    title = "Top DOC lakes with mean trophic position",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    size = "Mean trophic"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
